context: Implementation of items 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 from the game-expert consulting review: browser push notifications, prestige/rebirth, friend cheer co-op feature, weekly featured-crop event, and achievements.

features.2_browser_notifications: Settings panel has a notification-permission button. Once granted, every in-app notification also fires a real OS-level browser Notification, and planting schedules one for when that crop finishes growing. Honest limitation: only works while the tab is open (backgrounded is fine, fully closed is not) -- true closed-app push needs VAPID keys, a subscription table, and a server scheduler that would also require syncing farm state to the server, which is out of scope for this pass.
features.3_prestige_rebirth: Available from Settings once level 20+. Resets gold/level/harvest/inventory/farm for a permanent +3%-per-prestige multiplier on harvest and mission rewards. Upgrades, codex, and login data are kept. Has a confirmation step.
features.5_friend_cheer_coop: New cheers table + POST /api/cheer (one per friend per day, server-enforced). Cheer button on every user row; sender gets +50G immediately, recipient gets it as mail + notification on their next heartbeat (works even if offline now).
features.6_weekly_featured_crop: One seed deterministically chosen per ISO week (no server storage needed, same for all players), +20% harvest reward, highlighted in the shop with a star badge.
features.7_achievements: 6 achievements across existing systems (cars survived, missions won, favorited friends, distance traveled, lifetime gold earned, prestige reached), each with a gold bonus, checked automatically after relevant actions.

migration_safety: All new nested state objects use the same deep-merge + sanitization pattern established after the v43 seeds-desync bug.

verification.syntax: node --check passes on game.js, game-systems.js, cheer.js, and heartbeat.js.
verification.settings_and_achievements_tested: Confirmed settings exposes all 3 new entry points and achievements panel renders exactly 6 cards with correct progress count.
verification.prestige_flow_tested: Set level 25/gold 50000, confirmed unlock, confirmation dialog, and correct post-prestige state (gold reset plus the prestige achievement bonus stacking on top as expected, upgrades preserved, inventory cleared).
verification.notification_permission_tested: Confirmed the button respects an already-denied permission state rather than silently failing.
verification.cheer_flow_tested: Mocked backend test: cheer button grants sender +50G and becomes disabled/checked after use.
verification.weekly_event_tested: Confirmed the shop shows the featured-crop banner and star-marked highlighted card.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, stuck-at-node escape test, speed-equalization test, and standard headless-browser playthrough all pass with only expected harmless local-sandbox errors.

deployment_note_important: schema.sql needs to be re-applied to the project's D1 database for the new cheers table to exist.
